provider.name: World Flora Online
provider.organization_type: global plant taxonomy, nomenclature, accepted-name, synonym, classification, description, distribution, image, bibliography, source-dataset, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: World Flora Online is a global collaborative online flora covering vascular plants and bryophytes. It provides a taxonomic backbone, accepted names, synonyms, classifications, descriptions, distributions, references, images, and source provenance contributed by botanical institutions, floras, checklists, and expert networks.
institutional_context: Botanical gardens, herbaria, museums, universities, taxonomic institutes, and national floras
Contributing plant-name, checklist, classification, description, distribution, and image providers

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting World Flora Online documentation, organization, governance, partners, plant names, accepted taxa, synonyms, classifications, descriptions, distributions, images, references, source datasets, APIs, downloads, schemas, identifiers, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, nomenclatural codes, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: World Flora Online, its cited source datasets, original taxonomic publications, the International Code of Nomenclature, type repositories, contributing botanical institutions, official release files, and specialist taxonomic authorities remain authoritative for nomenclatural acts, accepted concepts, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.

notes: Verify whether World Flora Online currently exposes a supported public API and identify canonical routes.
Verify authentication, parameters, field names, filters, pagination, rate limits, response formats, error schemas, and versioning.

Do not infer undocumented editorial, administrative, or write endpoints from browser traffic.
Do not store credentials, API keys, passwords, cookies, tokens, or session identifiers.
Capture exact World Flora Online, source dataset, description, image, API, download, and software legal wording.
Separate nomenclatural facts, taxonomic concepts, descriptions, bibliography, images, API output, downloads, and software.
Preserve WFO ID, accepted WFO ID, source dataset, source record ID, release or modification date, file name, checksum, citation, access date, license URI, rights holder, and provenance.
Original publications and the International Code of Nomenclature remain authoritative for nomenclatural acts.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
World Flora Online routes, API availability, source-dataset pages, download products, schemas, field names, consortium pages, and legal wording may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every taxon, synonym, source, description, distribution, image, reference, or API result when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store passwords, API keys, cookies, tokens, private contributor records, or session identifiers.
Nomenclatural facts, taxonomic concepts, descriptions, images, references, API output, downloads, and software may carry different rights.

Always preserve WFO ID, accepted WFO ID, scientific name, authorship, rank, status, parent, classification, basionym, synonyms, nomenclatural status, type data, descriptions, distributions, references, source dataset and record ID, modification date, release, citation, rights, source URL, and provenance.
